parameters.name: ChannelId
parameters.description: The ID of the driver channel. Call the [QueryEdgeInstanceChannel](~~162253~~) operation to obtain the ID.

parameters.name: ChannelName
parameters.description: The name of the driver channel. The name can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, and underscores (_), and must be 1 to 30 characters in length.

sub_parameters.name: Content
sub_parameters.description:
The configuration content.

- If the value of the **Configs.N.Format** parameter is KV or JSON, specify the configuration content here. For the format of the configuration content, see [Driver channel configurations](~~172321~~).

- If the value of the **Configs.N.Format** parameter is FILE, specify the Object Storage Service (OSS) address here. Call the [CreateOssPreSignedAddress](~~155858~~) operation to obtain the OSS address.

sub_parameters.name: Format
sub_parameters.description: The format of the configuration. Valid values: KV (key-value pair), JSON (JSON format), FILE (configuration file).

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The key of the configuration. This parameter is used to distinguish configurations when multiple configurations exist.

parameters.name: DriverId
parameters.description:
The ID of the driver. On the **Driver Management** page of the [Link IoT Edge console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the target driver name to obtain the ID.

You can also call the [QueryEdgeDriver](~~155776~~) operation to obtain the ID.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the edge instance. On the **Edge Instances** page of the [Link IoT Edge console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the target edge instance name to obtain the ID.

You can also call the [QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~) operation to obtain the ID.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for public instances. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances.
